Power Pages Developer   Your new company    
 Join a leading WA Government department currently modernising a key business application within their Technology Services team. This role sits within Application Support Development and will play a critical part in upgrading a legacy Power Platform solution to a modern, scalable environment. 
   
  Your new role  
   
 We're seeking an experienced Power Platform Developer to support the upgrade of an existing application from Power Portal to Power Pages as part of a broader modernisation program. 
 You will take a hands-on role across development, integration, and deployment, working within an established Azure environment and contributing to the next phase of a key platform upgrade. 
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
   
 You will bring strong technical capability across the Microsoft ecosystem, with a focus on Power Platform development and modern delivery practices. 
   
  Key experience  
   
 
 Strong hands-on experience across the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages) 
 Proven experience upgrading or migrating legacy applications (ideally Power Portal ? Power Pages) 
 Solid understanding of Application Life cycle Management (ALM) and deployment pipelines 
 Experience integrating with Azure services (Function Apps, Logic Apps) 
 Technical capability across JavaScript, C#, REST APIs, and SQL 
 Strong understanding of Power Platform environments, security, and governance 
 
  Nice to have  
   
 
 Experience in government or regulated environments 
 Strong documentation and stakeholder engagement skills 
 
  What you'll get in return  
   
 
 Opportunity to work on a high-impact Power Platform modernisation project 
 Exposure to enterprise Azure and DevOps environments 
 Collaborative team with strong technical capability 
 Competitive contract rates under a government panel 
 
  What you need to do now . 
  If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
